description: Header file defining the InterleavedSincResampler class for audio resampling, including buffer management, kernel initialization, and resampling methods.

classes.name: InterleavedSincResampler
classes.description: A class for performing high-quality interleaved sinc resampling of audio data.

methods.name: QueueBuffer
methods.description: Appends a buffer of float samples to the resampler queue.

methods.name: Resample
methods.description: Resamples a specified number of frames into the destination buffer.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all buffered data and resets internal indices.

methods.name: CanQueueBuffer
methods.description: Checks if more buffers can be queued.

methods.name: HasEnoughData
methods.description: Checks if enough data is available for resampling.

methods.name: GetSampleRateRatio
methods.description: Returns the input/output sample rate ratio.

methods.name: GetNumberOfCachedFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames currently cached.
